documented_meaning: very reliable: all needed information available, measurements and analysis reliable
reliable: some estimations/calculations and/or some uncertainty, overall still reliable
less reliable: estimations/calculations and uncertainties lead to the class 'less reliable'
not reliable: no acceptable estimations possible and/or faulty measurements or calculations
simple: the parameters describe the cross-section exactly or very well
quite simple: the parameters describe the cross-section very well, although not exactly
quite complicated: the parameters describe the cross-section appreciably, but not exactly
very complicated: the cross-section is too complex for the chosen parameters; the representation is unreliable
